tei:titleStmt.tei:title: gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru:slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas lho nub srin po'i yul du gshegs pa'i dus su:gung thang la thog
gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru:slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas lho nub srin po'i yul du gshegs pa'i dus su:gung thang la thog

tei:div.tei:p: ))gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub bzhugs so// na mo gu ru: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas lho nub srin po'i yul du gshegs pa'i dus su: gung thang la thog tu lha sras mu khri btsan pos phyag dang bskor ba byas: zhabs spyi bos gtugs: na bza'i sleb mo la 'jus te: spyan chab phyungs nas bshum zhing smre sngags kyis zhu ba phul ba: kye ma gu ru rin po che: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: mang yul gung thang gangs 'gram 'dir: bdag gi bu brgyud gnas byas te: dmangs su 'bebs shing sdug bsngal na: bod kyi rgyal po snying re rje: bdag gi bu brgyud su la re: lus su dmag dang 'khrug pa byed: dben gnas gnyan po 'dral ba dang : ri klung jag pa'i rgyug sa byed: chos la sgrub long med pas na: bla mchod rnam gnyis 'o re brgyal: phyis 'byung dad ldan snying re rje: gtsug lag khang du 'khrugs khang byed: sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams bshig: dam rdzas mi nag skye bos spyod: dben sar bon gyis bswa sgra sgrogs: chos 'khor 'jig la thug pa na: dam pa'i rten rnams 'o re brgyal: chos 'khor bka' srung su la re: che btsun zas ngan dug gis gsod: mi chen srog la hur thum byed: ya rabs mnong pos dmangs su 'bebs: snying brtse'i grogs kyis blo brku na: bod kyi zhang blon snying re rje: rgyal po'i thugs gces su la re: nad mtshon mu ge'i bskal pa dar: mtha' yi mi bzhi dbus su shor: 'dre bgegs 'byung pos tsha rag gtong : ci mi 'dod pa 'byung ba na: 'bod 'bangs sdug bsngal snying re rje: skyabs med sems can su la re: khri srong lde'u btsan dgung la gshegs: gu ru o rgyan gnas la gshegs: mu khri btsan po bod du bor: yab rgyal po sku tshe thung lags so: gu ru thugs rje chung lags so: bdag gi bsod nams chung lags so: chos 'khor bstan pa nyams lags so: bod 'bangs skyid pa zad lags so: yab dang gu ru bzhugs dus su:

mu khri btsan po mi 'gum pa: bdag gi blo gtad su la 'cha': snying brtse'i gros ni su yis 'debs: dam pa'i chos ni su la zhu: 'chi dus 'pho ba su yis 'debs: bar do'i sdug bsngal su yis sel: sgrib sbyong phrin las su yis mdzad: kye ma kyi hud thugs rje chung : zhes smre sngags 'don cing lha sras dran med du brgyal lo: de nas slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis rgyal po'i snyan khung du ljags kyi chab gtor nas dran pa gsos: lha sras kyi dbu sku pang du blangs te: 'di skad gsungs so: nyon cig bod kyi rgyal po dad pa can: las can mos gus ldan pa nga yi bu: khri srong lde'u btsan sku tshe mtha' ru 'khyol: thugs ngal ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje: bdag ni da dung bod kyi don la mchi: dad pa can la dngos su dam chos ston: thugs ngal ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje: khyod kyi sdig sgrib thams cad ma lus pa: nga yi zhal mthong tsam la 'dag par nges: thugs ngal ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje: 'di dang phyi ma bar do'i gnas gsum du: nga dang yang yang mjal zhing sdug bsngal sel: thugs ngal ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje: 'di nas skye ba bcu drug 'gro don mdzod: de nas o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling du spyon: thugs ngal ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje: mang yul gung thang gangs ri'i 'dabs 'di ru: nyid kyi gdung brgyud phyi ma 'byon pa rnams: gdung brgyud ma nor chos kyi rgyal srid skyongs: nga yi thugs rjes rgyun chad med par gzigs: thugs ngal ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje: dben gnas chos mdzad dad gus ldan pa yis: rgyal ba'i bka' dang thugs rje'i gdul bya rnams: nga yi byin rlabs thugs rjes skyob lags kyi: thugs ngal ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje: skal med sdig spyod log lta bdud kyi rigs: rtog dpyod 'gran sems nag po'i sems can ni: bdag gis mi skyob las ngan dag la spyod:

da lta'i zhang blon nag po 'di rnams kyang : rje yi thugs dkrugs bdag gi dam las nyams: da dung ngan song gsum du nges par 'gro: 'on kyang nga yi zhal mthong gsung thos pas: tha ma las ngan dag nas bdag gi gdul byar skye: thugs ngal ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje: dus ngan tha ma mthar thug slebs ka ru: ri bo bkra bzang zhes bya'i shar 'dabs su: sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gcig gi smon lam gyis: nga yi gter 'don lha sras gdung brgyud skyob: thugs ngal ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje: dus ngan tha ma'i sems can zog pos 'dul: de yi skyon gyis log lta'i 'dam la tshud: chos dang chos 'dra mi 'byed the tshom che: ri bo bkra bzang 'dabs su 'byung ba de: gsang sngags theg pa chen po'i bka' dang mtshungs: dge ba'i tshul spyod sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pas: gung thang rgyal po rje 'bangs skyobs par nges: thugs ngal ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje: zhes gsungs so: de'i dus su rgyal po'i sdug bsngal sel byed nyon mongs rang grol zhes bya ba gsungs so: gu ru'i zhal nas: lha sras nyid bu 'bangs kyi don du thugs shin tu brtse bas: ngas rgyal po'i gdung brgyud rnams la dus snyigs ma'i mthar thug pa'i bar du byin rlabs thugs rjes skyob kyi: lha sras rang bu 'bangs la zhal chems 'di ltar du zhog ces gsungs so: rigs bzang khungs btsun 'od gsal lha yi brgyud: mu khri btsan po man chad gdung brgyud ma chad bar: bdag gi thugs rjes rgyun du bzung lags kyi: sdig spyod grogs dang blon po'i khar ma btang : rgyal khrims chos kyi khrims kyis 'tsho bar mdzod: chos med dred po zol zog g.yo sgyu can: snyigs dus 'byung bas tshar chod chos khrims tshugs: chos bzhin spyod pas rgyal khams bde bar 'gyur: sku srog nyen zhing mnga' thang 'phrog pa dang : rgyal po dmangs su 'bebs pa'i gal byung na: lha srin dpang du tshugs la bzlog pa mdzod:

snyigs dus gung thang rgyal por snying brtse'i phyir: brag ri dug sbrul spungs 'dra'i sked pa la: lha sras gdung brgyud skyob pa'i man ngag bdog: de dus skye 'gro mi rnams the tshom che: log lta ma byed nga yi bka' bzhin sgrubs: gung thang rgyal po'i bsam pa de yis 'grub: sdig spyod rgyal po bdag gis skyob mi 'gyur: zhes gsungs so: gu ru'i zhal nas: lha sras kyi gdung rabs tha ma mang yul gung thang du nga yi gter gyis skyob pa'i dus su: bod sdug pa'i dus la babs pa yin te: sems can la ci mi 'dod pa 'byung : steng lha srin 'khrugs: 'og klu gnyan 'khrugs: bar gzhi bdag 'khrugs: sdig spyod rgyal po 'khrugs: dmangs phal ba 'khrugs: pha spun nang 'khrugs: de'i dus su sangs rgyas bstan pa mtha' la thug: yi dam lha'i dngos grub yal: mkha' 'gro chos skyong ri rab la zhal gzigs: sems can gyi skyid pa zad pa yin: gung thang rgyal po yon mchod rje 'bangs rnams: nga yi bka' bzhin sgrubs la gter gyi chos la spyod: pad+ma bdag gi thugs rje myur la stobs che ba de'i dus su 'byung ngo : dus rgyun chad med par nga la gsol ba thob ces gsungs so: ༈ e ma hoḥ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su: snang ba mtha' yas thugs rje'i byin rlabs g.yos: sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas byin brlabs te: 'dzam bu'i gling du 'gro ba'i don la byon: 'gro don rgyun chad med pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan man chad nas: chos rgyal gdung brgyud mtha' la ma stongs bar: dus gsum rgyun chad med par byin gyis rlobs: bod kyi chos skyong rgyal po'i gnyen gcig pu: rgyal po chos spyod skyong ba'i thugs rje can: o rgyan= bsam pa= sku ni lho nub srin po'i kha gnon mdzad:

thugs rjes bod kyi sems can yongs la gzigs: ma rig log pa'i sems can 'dren pa'i dpal: nyon mongs gdul dka'i sems can thabs kyis 'dul: brtse gdung rgyun chad med pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan= bsam pa= dus ngan snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug pa'i tshe: nangs re dgong re bod kyi don la byon: nyi zer 'char sdud mdangs la bcibs te byon: yar ngo tshes bcu'i dus su dngos su byon: 'gro don stobs chen mdzad pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan= bsam pa= lnga brgya'i tha ma rtsod dus snyigs ma la: sems can thams cad nyon mongs dug lnga rags: nyon mongs 'byol nyog dug lnga rang rgyud spyod: de 'dra'i dus na khyed 'dra'i thugs rjes skyobs: dad ldan mtho ris 'dren pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan= bsam pa= hor sog 'jigs pa'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: chos 'khor gnyan po 'jig la thug pa'i tshe: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad 'khor gyis bskor: hor sog dmag dpung bzlog par the tshom med: o rgyan= bsam pa= sems can sgyu lus 'jig pa'i nad byung tshe: mi bzod sdug bsngal nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis the tshom med= o rgyan sman gyi bla dang dbyer med pas: tshe zad ma yin bar chad nges par sel: o rgyan= bsam pa= 'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyams pa'i tshe: sems can mu ge'i nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis= o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas: dbul phongs bkres skoms sel bar the tshom med: o rgyan= bsam pa= las can 'gro ba'i don du gter 'don na: dam tshig zol zog med pa'i dpa' gdeng gis: yid gnyis= o rgyan yi dam lha dang dbyer med pas: pha nor bu yis lon par the tshom med: o rgyan= bsam pa= sbas yul nags khrod dben sa snyogs pa'i tshe: kha char bu yug 'tshubs shing lam 'gags na: yid gnyis= o rgyan gzhi bdag gnyan po'i 'khor gyis bskor:

chos mdzad lam sna 'dren par the tshom med: o rgyan= bsam pa= stag gzig dom dred dug sbrul mche ba can: 'brog chen 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe: yid gnyis= o rgyan dpa' bo ging dang srung mar bcas: gdug pa'i sems can skrod par the tshom med: o rgyan= bsam pa= sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i bar chad kyis: sgyu lus nyen cing 'jig pa'i dus byung tshe: yid gnyis= o rgyan 'byung ba bzhi yi lha mor bcas: 'byung ba rang sar zhi bar the tshom med: o rgyan= bsam pa= lam srang 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe: bsad khyer jag pa chom pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis= o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi yi dgongs par ldan: tsau ra mi rgod rngam sems brlag par byed: o rgyan= bsam pa= gang zhig gshed ma'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: mtshon cha rnon pos 'debs shing nyen pa na: yid gnyis= o rgyan rdo rje'i gur dang ldan pa yis: gshed ma bred cing mtshon cha 'thor bar 'gyur: o rgyan= bsam pa= nam zhig tshe zad 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe: gnad gcod sdug bsngal drag pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis= o rgyan snang ba mtha' yas sprul pa ste: bde ba can gyi zhing du nges par skye: o rgyan= bsam pa= sgyu lus g.yar po zhig pa'i bar do ru: 'khrul snang nying 'khrul sdug bsngal nyen pa na: yid gnyis= o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs rje yis: 'khrul snang rang sar grol bar the tshom med: o rgyan= bsam pa= gzhan yang las dang rkyen gyi dbang gyur te: 'khrul snang dngos por zhen cing sdug bsngal na: yid gnyis= o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i ngo bo ste: sdug bsngal 'khrul pa rtsad nas gzhig par byed: o rgyan= bsam pa= 'gro drug sdug bsngal chen pos nyen pa dang : khyad par bod kyi rje 'bangs sdug bsngal na: dad gus mos pa'i gdung shugs drag po yis: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan thugs rjes 'pho 'gyur med par gzigs:

o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zhes gsungs nas: lha sras la thugs brtse bas dgongs te yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i man ngag bcu gsum gnang ngo : de nas lha sras kyis gus pas phyag dang bskor ba byas: gu ru o rgyan gyi yul du zhal gzigs nas nyi zer la bcibs nas bzhud do: lha sras mu khri btsan pos nyon mongs rang grol gyi man ngag dang : yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i man ngag zhal chems dang bcas pa mang yul gyi brag rin chen spungs pa 'dra ba la gter du sbas: gter bdag bse'i lha mo mched bzhi la bcol lo: nam zhig dus kyi tha ma la: nga yi gdung brgyud sdug pa'i dus: ri bo bkra bzang shar 'dabs nas: las can skyes bu 'byung ba'i tshe: de tshe de yis rnyed gyur nas: bdag gi gdung brgyud skyob par shog: ces gsungs so: sā māṅka: lha sras mu khri btsan po'i zhal nas: nga yi bu 'bangs dad gus ldan pa rnams: bla ma sku gsum gyi gsol 'debs de: skyabs bla ma nam dran dus na gsol ba thob: yab rgyal po la gsungs pa de: srod drag po'i dus su gsol ba thob: jo mo mtsho rgyal la gsungs pa de: tho rangs rgyas pa'i dus su gsol ba thob: dge slong nam mkha'i snying po la gsungs pa de: nam langs zhi ba'i dus su gsol ba thob: sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms la gsungs pa de: dgong mo dbang gi dus su gsol ba thob: lha sras mu khri btsan po la gsungs pa de: nam gung mun pa'i smag la gsol ba thob: gung thang rgyal po la gsungs pa de: nyin gung brel ba spongs la gsol ba thob: spyir sdug bsngal gyis nyen dus gsol ba thob: bdag rgyal po'i gdung brgyud ma nor zhing : chos tshul bzhin spyod pa'i las can la: spyir sangs rgyas thams cad bka' drin che: sgos gu ru'i bka' drin bsam mi khyab: bdag chos skyong rgyal po'i ngag la nyon: dus rgyun du mos pas gsol ba thob:

ces gsungs so: gung thang rgyal po la gsungs pa'i gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub ma zhes bya ba 'di ni: lha sras mu khri btsan pos ru lag gram pa rgyang gi lha khang du sbas so: gter bdag lha mo dre'u zhon ma la bcol lo: sā māṅga: shā bā: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: chu pho 'brug gi lor ru lag rgyang gi lha khang nas sprul sku bzang po grags pas gter nas bton te: rig 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ldem 'phru can la gtad: rig 'dzin chen pos shog ser las bsgyur ba'o: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: :
